name: proto-default-roots-import-unresolved
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the import roots are buf's for a directory with no buf.yaml, the target root, besides the include roots of upstream copies: an import no root resolves fails its file as protoc fails it, so the file publishes no declaration, the one that needs nothing from the import included, and carries an unresolved-import note, and a file importing it fails too, with a schema-unparsed note. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
